layout: cells.<field>[cell] for row, col, state and the static fields; cells.<field>[cell][month] for the rest, months in `months` order. speed, dir and gust_ratio_x100_sum are null in a month that fails the keep rule at month_share (no snow and no lake ice). ice is null in a cell with zero lake cover. Gust hours equal the sum of dir. Temperature days equal month_days. Speed sums to 3 x month_days.
